script_text: Aquarius, Uranus is throwing lightning bolts at your career sector—don't ignore this cosmic alert. The Sun is conjunct your ruling planet Uranus in your 10th House of Career, creating powerful ignition of your professional ambitions. Meanwhile, Mars is squaring your Moon in the 4th House of Home, making emotional clarity difficult. This tension between your public standing and private life is real today. If you're single, a surprise encounter could spark immediate chemistry—don't overthink it. If taken, your partner needs space to process their feelings today, so give them room without taking it personally. A financial opportunity is emerging in your 2nd House of Income—keep your eyes open for unexpected offers before week's end. The stars are aligning for a potential raise discussion. Avoid making major purchases today—the retrograde energy is still lurking in your financial sector. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what's coming for Aquarius.
